mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour BTC close breaking beyond its documented twenty-period, two-standard-deviation LEAN Regression Channel identifies displacement beyond the fitted trend envelope; follow the breakout for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when close newly crosses strictly above the upper channel; short when close newly crosses strictly below the lower channel
mechanism.why_distinct: The channel combines a rolling OLS endpoint projection with the population standard deviation of the same raw close levels. It is not a fixed mean band, Donchian/Keltner/Bollinger rule, fitted outcome, volume, flow, OI, funding, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: a close must escape a trend-adjusted price-dispersion envelope while completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour OLS-endpoint channel escapes are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.ols: chronological rolling 20-close intercept and slope evaluated at x=20
features.dispersion: population standard deviation with divisor 20 over the same raw closes
features.channels: OLS endpoint plus/minus two times dispersion
features.event: close newly strictly above upper from not above gives +1; close newly strictly below lower from not below gives -1; transitions between inside and the opposite band require an actual outer crossing
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: rolling OLS, dispersion, and crossing state reset after any invalid completed four-hour bar

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official LEAN RegressionChannel(20,2) outer breakout under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, width, regression, dispersion, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: canonical Regression Channel; QuantConnect LEAN implementation
external_basis.fixed_definition: documented period=20 and k=2; OLS on chronological x=1..20 and closes, endpoint=intercept+slope*20; population standard deviation of the same 20 raw close levels; upper/lower=endpoint +/- 2*std; warmup 20
external_basis.selection_use: official documented period, width, population dispersion, endpoint projection, and outer-channel breakout only; no incidence or outcomes
